title: Computational Analysis of Plasma Lipidomics from Mice Fed Standard Chow and Ketogenic Diet
author: Amy L. Seufert

steps.title: Acclimate mice with softened food
steps.instruction: Allow age‑matched (4–6 weeks) female BALB/c mice to acclimate undisturbed for one week, providing PicoLab Mouse Diet 20 softened with water.

steps.title: Switch diets two weeks before collection
steps.instruction: Separate mice into groups and change diets to standard chow (Envigo TD.08485) or ketogenic diet (Envigo TD.180423) two weeks prior to plasma collection; keep KD refrigerated, change daily, and clean/replace cages every three days.

steps.title: Prepare heparin‑coated syringes
steps.instruction: Immediately before euthanasia, dilute heparin sodium (VWR AAA16198‑03) to 100 IU/mL in 1× PBS (Thermo Fisher 20012050) making ~5 mL solution; aspirate and expel the solution with each 3 mL BD Luer‑Lok syringe (25 G × 5/8 in., catalog 309570) to coat the needle, then rest syringes on sterile needle caps with bevel up.

steps.title: Set up collection supplies on ice
steps.instruction: Prepare BD Vacutainer blood collection tubes (catalog 366667), an ice bucket, and set the tabletop centrifuge temperature to 4 °C.

steps.title: Euthanize mouse and perform cardiac puncture
steps.instruction: Euthanize each mouse individually with CO₂ (fill rate 30 %–70 % of chamber volume per minute); before cervical dislocation, place the mouse supine on the bench and quickly draw blood via cardiac puncture using the heparin‑coated syringe. Use a needle gauge between 23 G and 25 G to avoid hemolysis.

steps.title: Collect blood on ice
steps.instruction: Transfer 200–700 µL of blood (volume depends on mouse size) into a BD Vacutainer tube and keep the tube on ice.

steps.title: Centrifuge blood to obtain plasma
steps.instruction: Move the blood sample to an Axygen Maxy Clear Snap‑lock microcentrifuge tube (catalog 10011‑700) and centrifuge at 1 500 × g for 20 min at 4 °C.

steps.title: Aliquot and store plasma
steps.instruction: Transfer the clear plasma supernatant to a fresh microcentrifuge tube, seal with Parafilm M (catalog S37440), and store at –80 °C or ship on dry ice for later processing.

steps.title: Extract lipids from plasma
steps.instruction: Thaw frozen plasma (20 µL) and add 480 µL lipid‑extraction solvent (methylene chloride : methanol : isopropanol = 25 : 10 : 65, v/v/v) containing 0.1 % BHT; vortex 30 s, then centrifuge 10 min at 13 000 rpm at 4 °C.

steps.title: Prepare sample for mass spectrometry
steps.instruction: Transfer 95 µL of the clarified extract to a mass‑spectrometry analysis tube and spike with 5 µL SPLASH LipidoMix (Avanti Lipids) internal standard mixture.

steps.title: Run UPLC‑QTOF MS analysis
steps.instruction: Inject the sample onto a Waters 1.7 µm, 2.1 × 100 mm CSH C18 column coupled to an AB SCIEX TripleTOF 5600 quadrupole‑TOF MS operating in information‑dependent MS/MS mode. Use LC/MS conditions as described by Choi et al. (2015) with the following mobile phases: positive‑ion mode – Phase A: 60 % acetonitrile / 40 % water with 10 mM ammonium formate and 0.1 % formic acid; Phase B: 90 % isopropanol / 10 % acetonitrile with 10 mM ammonium formate and 0.1 % formic acid. For negative‑ion mode, use ammonium acetate (10 mM) as the modifier.
